Before any value in this report was calculated, the NeoIPC validation rules were applied to the data of every department contributing to the reference data.
A record a rule flags is removed from the dataset together with the whole patient record it belongs to — the patient's admissions and forms — unless an exception list names it, and the removed records are not part of any value in this report.
The table below shows, for each rule that removed or exempted a record, how many records of which kind it concerned, and the totals across all rules.
The rules are numbered as in the NeoIPC Validation Report, which explains each rule.
